Copy number segment track

Source: R/geom-copy-number.R
geom_copy_number.Rd

Draws copy number segments as thin horizontal bars at their integer copy number, as in gTrack. xmin, xmax, and y default to the start, end, and total_cn columns, as in JaBbA copy number profiles; map y to another column such as major_allele to change it. Segments are filled by their integer copy number with scale_fill_copynumber() unless fill is mapped or set, e.g. by state with aes(fill = cn_state) and scale_fill_cn_state(). Bars use fill so colour stays free for geom_junction() in the same plot.

Segments above cn_cap are drawn at the cap and marked with a triangle, so a few highly amplified segments do not flatten the rest of the profile. Adjacent segments are joined by thin gray reference connectors, as in JaBbA genome graphs.

With alleles, the major and minor allele copy numbers are drawn as two semi-transparent series, red and blue, so where they are equal the bars overlap in purple.

Also adds a y-axis scale with whole-number breaks starting at zero and a "Copy Number" y-axis title. Add your own scale_y_continuous() or labs() after it to override them.

Usage

geom_copy_number(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  cn_cap = NULL,
  bar_height = 1.5,
  connectors = TRUE,
  alleles = NULL,
  show_first_y_label = TRUE,
  ...,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping

Set of aesthetic mappings created by ggplot2::aes(), e.g. fill.

data

GRanges object or data frame of copy number segments with seqnames, start, end, and total_cn columns, e.g. a JaBbA cnv.bed profile.

cn_cap

Highest copy number shown, default: no cap. Segments above it are drawn at the cap with a triangle marker.

bar_height

Height of the bars in mm, default: 1.5

connectors

Join adjacent segments with thin gray lines, default: TRUE. Segments are assumed to come from one sample per layer.

alleles

Draw allele-specific copy number instead of total copy number, by giving the major and minor allele columns, e.g. c("major_allele", "minor_allele"), or TRUE for those JaBbA column names. Default: NULL for total copy number.

show_first_y_label

Label the lowest y-axis break, default: TRUE. See label_drop_first().

...

Other arguments passed to ggplot2::layer(), e.g. fill, colour (bar outline), or alpha.

na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

See ggplot2::layer().

Value

List of a ggplot2 layer, a y-axis scale, a y-axis title, and a copy number fill scale unless fill is given, added to a plot with +

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cn <- data.table::fread("sample.jabba.phased.cnv.bed")
data.table::setnames(cn, "chrom", "seqnames")

ggplot2::ggplot(cn) +
  geom_copy_number(cn_cap = 8) +
  coord_genome() +
  theme_genomic()
} # }
